units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 22a">Kidd. 22ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 21:12">Deut. XXI, 12</cite>) ‘thou shalt bring her to thy house’ <he>מלמד שלא יִלְחֲצֶנָּהּ במלחמה</he> this intimates that he must not urge her (to yield to him) during the war.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 59b:12">B. Mets. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>והלוֹחֲצוֹ</he> and he who presses him (the stranger), contrad. to <he>אִנָּה</he>.—Part. pass. <he>לָחוּץ</he>, pl. <he>לְחוּצִים</he>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 11:1">Num. R. s. 11</cite> <he>דחוקים ול׳</he> pushed and pressed.
